lines.beaver: 우리가 알고 지낸 지 벌써 이십 년이네.
lines.beaver_en: It's already been twenty years since we met.
lines.beaver_roman: Uriga algo jinaen ji beolsseo isim nyeonine.
lines.en: Yeah, no friend is as close to me as you.

lines.beaver: 그동안 우리 사이를 흔드는 소문도 많았지?
lines.beaver_en: There were plenty of rumors that shook us, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Geudongan uri saireul heundeuneun somundo manatji?
lines.learner: 유언비어가 돌아도 난 늘 네 편이었지.
lines.en: Even when false rumors spread, I was always on your side.
lines.roman: Yueonbieoga doado nan neul ne pyeonieotji.

lines.beaver: 그때 넌 왜 끝까지 내 곁에 있었어?
lines.beaver_en: Why did you stay by my side to the end back then?
lines.beaver_roman: Geuttae neon wae kkeutkkaji nae gyeote isseosseo?
lines.learner: 비록 손해를 볼지언정 신의를 지키고 싶었어.
lines.en: Even if I lost out, I wanted to keep faith with you.
lines.roman: Birok sonhaereul boljieonjeong sinuireul jikigo sipeosseo.

lines.beaver: 내가 가게 문 닫았을 때도 기억나?
lines.beaver_en: Do you remember when I had to close my shop?
lines.beaver_roman: Naega gage mun dadasseul ttaedo gieongna?
lines.en: Our friends all chipped in money to help, remember?

lines.beaver: 그때 정말 큰 힘이 됐어. 고마워.
lines.beaver_en: That really gave me strength. Thank you.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuttae jeongmal keun himi dwaesseo. Gomawo.
lines.learner: 네 기운을 북돋우는 건 당연한 일이었지.
lines.en: Lifting your spirits was the obvious thing to do.
lines.roman: Ne giuneul bukdoduneun geon dangyeonhan irieotji.

lines.beaver: 우리 우정이 이렇게 오래간 비결이 뭘까?
lines.beaver_en: What's the secret to our friendship lasting so long?
lines.beaver_roman: Uri ujeongi ireoke oraegan bigyeori mwolkka?
lines.learner: 말 안 해도 통하는 교감과 유대감 덕분이야.
lines.en: It's the rapport and bond we share without words.
lines.roman: Mal an haedo tonghaneun gyogamgwa yudaegam deokbuniya.

lines.beaver: 그러고 보니 우리 둘은 성격도 비슷해.
lines.beaver_en: Come to think of it, we even have similar personalities.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureogo boni uri dureun seonggyeokdo biseutae.
lines.en: Birds of a feather, they say—that's exactly us.

lines.beaver: 넌 친구 사이에 뭐가 제일 중요한 것 같아?
lines.beaver_en: What do you think matters most between friends?
lines.beaver_roman: Neon chingu saie mwoga jeil jungyohan geot gata?
lines.learner: 차라리 혼자 지낼지언정 가짜 우정은 싫어.
lines.en: I'd rather live alone than have a fake friendship.
lines.roman: Charari honja jinaeljieonjeong gajja ujeongeun sireo.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 그래서 우리 사이가 이렇게 돈독한가 봐.
lines.beaver_en: Right. Maybe that's why we're so close.
lines.beaver_roman: Maja. Geuraeseo uri saiga ireoke dondokanga bwa.
lines.learner: 앞으로도 우리 우정 돈독하게 지켜 가자.
lines.en: Let's keep our friendship strong from now on, too.
lines.roman: Apeurodo uri ujeong dondokage jikyeo gaja.

lines.beaver: 그래, 넌 정말 좋은 벗이야. 다음 주에 밥 먹자.
lines.beaver_en: Sure, you're a truly good friend. Let's eat next week.
lines.beaver_roman: Geurae, neon jeongmal joeun beosiya. Daeum jue bap meokja.
lines.en: Great, it's on me. See you then!
